operational-example.copy: Render a governed conversation log from Chat Message records with empty, loading, offline, error, selected-message, and handoff states.

rationale: Avoids local visual or workflow duplication.

items.rule: Composes Surface as the labelled log boundary.
Renders ordered Chat Message records without raw message shells.
Composes Empty State for empty, loading, offline, error, or handoff recovery.
Uses Focus and State for selected message review.

accessibility.statePrecedence: error > offline > loading > handoff > empty > default
items: Keep visible labels and accessible names aligned.
Expose machine-readable state through props and data attributes.
Do not rely on color, symbol, or placeholder text alone.
Preserve keyboard, focus, disabled, loading, and recovery behavior.

variants.copy: chat-thread variants stay semantic and do not fork visual contracts.

states.copy: Chat Thread states keep the log, empty, loading, offline, error, and handoff boundaries owned by Flow components and primitives.

api-foundations.copy: chat-thread API exposes semantic props while Flow foundations own state, density, tone, frame, and accessibility.

props.name: state
props.type: default | loading | empty | error | handoff | offline
